Listen to an announcement from the director of international programs.
Good afternoon. I'm sorry to share that we've decided to suspend the spring semester program in the coastal region of Ecuador. This was not an easy decision. Our partner university there has been an excellent host for fifteen years, and the program is consistently among our most highly rated. However, recent flooding has damaged several of the facilities where students would live and study, and our partner has told us candidly that repairs won't be complete by January. Students who were accepted have two options: transfer to our program in the highlands near Quito, which has a similar focus on ecology and indigenous agriculture, or defer to the fall semester, when we fully expect the coastal program to resume. Either way, your application fees will carry over.

choices: The partner university decided to end its fifteen-year agreement.
Too few students applied.
The program received poor ratings.
Flood damage to facilities will not be repaired in time.
answer: Flood damage to facilities will not be repaired in time.
explanation: 洪水で施設が損傷し、1月までに修理が終わらないため。

passage:
Listen to an announcement from the university's provost.
I'd like to share some news about tuition and financial support for next year. As many of you know, the state has reduced its contribution to our operating budget for the second year in a row. As a result, the board has approved a tuition increase of three percent—below the rate of inflation, but an increase nonetheless. At the same time, we're expanding what we call our tuition guarantee: students from families earning under sixty thousand dollars a year will have tuition fully covered through grants, with no loans required. Previously, the threshold was forty-five thousand. In other words, while the headline cost goes up, the actual cost for roughly a third of our students will fall to zero. We believe this reflects our obligation to keep the university accessible.

It will be canceled if the state provides more money.
It is smaller than the rate of inflation.
It only applies to new students.
answer: It is smaller than the rate of inflation.
explanation: 3%の値上げはインフレ率を下回ると述べている。
